sectionText.klima: The effects of climate change in Heilbronn are perceptible and measurable. Heilbronn aims to become climate-neutral and climate-adapted, living up to its responsibility for a "better tomorrow". This requires the entire city community!
sectionText.energie: Whether at home, in business, or as a municipality, these principles are the building blocks of a successful energy transition: Avoiding energy consumption is the top priority. Unavoidable energy needs must be reduced using efficient technology. The remaining energy demand must be fully covered by renewable energy sources in the medium term.
sectionText.mobilitaet: The goal of functional, climate-friendly mobility poses a major challenge for a growing city like Heilbronn. If the entire city community is willing to take new paths, this challenge can be mastered.
sectionText.gebaeude: For the goal of a climate-neutral and climate-adapted city, the role of buildings in Heilbronn can hardly be overestimated. Not only is the CO₂ savings potential particularly high in this area. Building owners can also save energy costs and protect their building from extreme weather through targeted measures.
